said.q: Anton Mauve In the evening of the day on which Van Gogh makes this painting, he finds a letter from his sister, who writes to tell him that Anton Mauve has died. This painter was not only his cousin by marriage; he also taught him to paint in oils and watercolour.

events.n: spring of 1888; one of fourteen paintings of blossoming trees
events.q: When the fruit trees in Arles are in bloom in the spring of 1888, Van Gogh paints them nearly every day.

events.n: dedicated to Anton Mauve on news of his death; inscribed 'Souvenir de Mauve Vincent & Theo'
events.q: Van Gogh decides to dedicate the work to him.

events.n: inventory number KM 108.317; stated in Collectie Nederland
